item.description:
### Organisation Policy
- Screen-time limits set in the console are now enforced: the app is blocked once its daily budget is used, and a countdown shows while it is in front. - Mindful Pause apps set in the console now pause before they open, with the console's breath length and delay before pausing again. - The Blocker and Mindful Pause screens list what your organisation has set.
### Mindful Pause
- The breathing screen now covers only the app's window, so it appears on the right display when you use more than one. - The buttons are no wider than other buttons in the app.
### Website Blocker
- The block page names the right app when two apps are blocked back to back.
### Prayers
- Signing out now clears your prayer location, so the notification prompt no longer appears over onboarding when you sign back in.
### Onboarding
- The "How To Activate" screen has a centred title and a fixed header, with only the steps scrolling.
### Updates
- Update information is now verified before it is trusted.
